title: Insulin and HOMA index
what: This is a blood test from a vein. Insulin and blood sugar are measured together. From them, the HOMA index is calculated. It shows how your body responds to insulin.
why: For extra weight, possible insulin resistance, irregular periods, or high blood sugar.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: If you have diabetes and what sugar medicines you take
What other medicines you take regularly

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Strictly fasting: usually no food for 8 to 12 hours. Even sweet tea or chewing gum will change the result. Water is fine.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: For 24 hours, no alcohol and no hard workouts. Best not to smoke in the morning.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything should change.

steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tightened above your elbow
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick, and blood fills a tube
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes and keep your arm straight
You can eat right away and go back to your usual day
Results usually come in 1 to 2 days. The lab will tell you when
The lab or your doctor will calculate the HOMA index

faq.q: Why is insulin tested together with sugar?
faq.a: The HOMA index uses both numbers. They must come from the same blood sample.

faq.q: Can I have black coffee before the test?

reminders.text: Insulin test tomorrow. Do not eat after dinner. Plain water is fine.
